title: Production Linked Incentive Scheme
definition: The Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme is an outcome-based flagship financial stimulus policy introduced by the Government of India to incentivize incremental sales of products manufactured in domestic units, aiming to boost domestic manufacturing, reduce import dependence, and integrate India into global value chains (GVCs).
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC Civil Services Examination under GS Paper III (Indian Economy - Industrial Growth, Make in India, Export Competitiveness, Technology, and Budgeting) and Prelims (Government Schemes, Economic Policy, Subsidies).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Production Linked Incentive Scheme.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
